verdict.rationale: Teller publishes a per-endpoint API reference covering balances, transactions, identity, payments, webhooks and authentication. A simulated-data sandbox with test credentials lets developers run calls against the API. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or has in-page runnable examples, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec that could power a try-it console. Missing for 10: interactive try-it console, runnable in-doc examples, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of the docs experience.
